answer: Sybil resistance via renewal-decay reputation: each identity's standing weight halves every epoch unless refreshed by verified graded work, so an attacker must pay continuous work costs per alias, not once. Entry is an exit-bonded harbor: joining the island economy requires a bond forfeited on abandonment, making mass alias creation a losing trade. A willow-like trustee guild vouches only for identities whose refresh payments settle; colluding guilds burn their own decayed weight when a vouched alias is invalidated, so cost grows super-linearly for any coalition.
